statement: For every pair of attributed compact metric-measure spaces and every alpha in [0,1], the CDOT objective attains an optimum over the fixed-marginal coupling set and is convex in the coupling.
domain: Attributed compact metric-measure spaces with the paper's continuous feature maps and bounded distance operators.

quantifiers.spaces: all attributed compact metric-measure spaces in Definition 2.1

acceptance_obligations: weak lower semicontinuity of both objective terms
affine dependence of the conditional-expectation operator on the coupling
non_circularity: No sample size, tolerance, or expected numerical slope is derived from the theorem's upper bound. The population conclusion is carried by the reconstructed analytical obligations, not by finite panels.
